vulg: Paulus apostolus non ab hominibus neque per hominem sed per Iesum Christum et Deum Patrem qui suscitavit eum a mortuis
clem: Paulus, Apostolus non ab hominibus, neque per hominem, sed per Jesum Christum, et Deum Patrem, qui suscitavit eum a mortuis:
tr: παυλος αποστολος ουκ απ ανθρωπων ουδε δι ανθρωπου αλλα δια ιησου χριστου και θεου πατρος του εγειραντος αυτον εκ νεκρων
kjv: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

vulg: et qui mecum sunt omnes fratres ecclesiis Galatiae
clem: et qui mecum sunt omnes fratres, ecclesiis Galati.
tr: και οι συν εμοι παντες αδελφοι ταις εκκλησιαις της γαλατιας
kjv: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

vulg: gratia vobis et pax a Deo Patre et Domino nostro Iesu Christo
clem: Gratia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre, et Domino nostro Jesu Christo,
tr: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος και κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

vulg: qui dedit semet ipsum pro peccatis nostris ut eriperet nos de praesenti saeculo nequam secundum voluntatem Dei et Patris nostri
clem: qui dedit semetipsum pro peccatis nostris, ut eriperet nos de prsenti sculo nequam, secundum voluntatem Dei et Patris nostri,
tr: του δοντος εαυτον υπερ των αμαρτιων ημων οπως εξεληται ημας εκ του ενεστωτος αιωνος πονηρου κατα το θελημα του θεου και πατρος ημων
kjv: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

vulg: cui est gloria in saecula saeculorum amen
clem: cui est gloria in scula sculorum. Amen.
tr: ω η δοξα εις τους αιωνας των αιωνων αμην
kjv: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

vulg: miror quod sic tam cito transferimini ab eo qui vos vocavit in gratiam Christi in aliud evangelium
clem: Miror quod sic tam cito transferimini ab eo qui vos vocavit in gratiam Christi in aliud Evangelium:
tr: θαυμαζω οτι ουτως ταχεως μετατιθεσθε απο του καλεσαντος υμας εν χαριτι χριστου εις ετερον ευαγγελιον
kjv: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

vulg: quod non est aliud nisi sunt aliqui qui vos conturbant et volunt convertere evangelium Christi
clem: quod non est aliud, nisi sunt aliqui qui vos conturbant, et volunt convertere Evangelium Christi.
tr: ο ουκ εστιν αλλο ει μη τινες εισιν οι ταρασσοντες υμας και θελοντες μεταστρεψαι το ευαγγελιον του χριστου
kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

vulg: sed licet nos aut angelus de caelo evangelizet vobis praeterquam quod evangelizavimus vobis anathema sit
clem: Sed licet nos aut angelus de clo evangelizet vobis prterquam quod evangelizavimus vobis, anathema sit.
tr: αλλα και εαν ημεις η αγγελος εξ ουρανου ευαγγελιζηται υμιν παρ ο ευηγγελισαμεθα υμιν αναθεμα εστω
kjv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

vulg: sicut praediximus et nunc iterum dico si quis vobis evangelizaverit praeter id quod accepistis anathema sit
clem: Sicut prdiximus, et nunc iterum dico: si quis vobis evangelizaverit prter id quod accepistis, anathema sit.
tr: ως προειρηκαμεν και αρτι παλιν λεγω ει τις υμας ευαγγελιζεται παρ ο παρελαβετε αναθεμα εστω
kjv: As we said before, so say I now again, if any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

vulg: modo enim hominibus suadeo aut Deo aut quaero hominibus placere si adhuc hominibus placerem Christi servus non essem
clem: Modo enim hominibus suadeo, an Deo? an quro hominibus placere? si adhuc hominibus placerem, Christi servus non essem.
tr: αρτι γαρ ανθρωπους πειθω η τον θεον η ζητω ανθρωποις αρεσκειν ει γαρ ετι ανθρωποις ηρεσκον χριστου δουλος ουκ αν ημην
kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

vulg: notum enim vobis facio fratres evangelium quod evangelizatum est a me quia non est secundum hominem
clem: Notum enim vobis facio, fratres, Evangelium, quod evangelizatum est a me, quia non est secundum hominem:
tr: γνωριζω δε υμιν αδελφοι το ευαγγελιον το ευαγγελισθεν υπ εμου οτι ουκ εστιν κατα ανθρωπον
kjv: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

vulg: neque enim ego ab homine accepi illud neque didici sed per revelationem Iesu Christi
clem: neque enim ego ab homine accepi illud, neque didici, sed per revelationem Jesu Christi.
tr: ουδε γαρ εγω παρα ανθρωπου παρελαβον αυτο ουτε εδιδαχθην αλλα δι αποκαλυψεως ιησου χριστου
kjv: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

vulg: audistis enim conversationem meam aliquando in iudaismo quoniam supra modum persequebar ecclesiam Dei et expugnabam illam
clem: Audistis enim conversationem meam aliquando in Judaismo: quoniam supra modum persequebar Ecclesiam Dei, et expugnabam illam,
tr: ηκουσατε γαρ την εμην αναστροφην ποτε εν τω ιουδαισμω οτι καθ υπερβολην εδιωκον την εκκλησιαν του θεου και επορθουν αυτην
kjv: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

vulg: et proficiebam in iudaismo supra multos coetaneos in genere meo abundantius aemulator existens paternarum mearum traditionum
clem: et proficiebam in Judaismo supra multos cotaneos meos in genere meo, abundantius mulator existens paternarum mearum traditionum.
tr: και προεκοπτον εν τω ιουδαισμω υπερ πολλους συνηλικιωτας εν τω γενει μου περισσοτερως ζηλωτης υπαρχων των πατρικων μου παραδοσεων
kjv: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

vulg: cum autem placuit ei qui me segregavit de utero matris meae et vocavit per gratiam suam
clem: Cum autem placuit ei, qui me segregavit ex utero matris me, et vocavit per gratiam suam,
tr: οτε δε ευδοκησεν ο θεος ο αφορισας με εκ κοιλιας μητρος μου και καλεσας δια της χαριτος αυτου
kjv: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,

vulg: ut revelaret Filium suum in me ut evangelizarem illum in gentibus continuo non adquievi carni et sanguini
clem: ut revelaret Filium suum in me, ut evangelizarem illum in gentibus: continuo non acquievi carni et sanguini,
tr: αποκαλυψαι τον υιον αυτου εν εμοι ινα ευαγγελιζωμαι αυτον εν τοις εθνεσιν ευθεως ου προσανεθεμην σαρκι και αιματι
kjv: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

vulg: neque veni Hierosolyma ad antecessores meos apostolos sed abii in Arabiam et iterum reversus sum Damascum
clem: neque veni Jerosolymam ad antecessores meos Apostolos: sed abii in Arabiam, et iterum reversus sum Damascum:
tr: ουδε ανηλθον εις ιεροσολυμα προς τους προ εμου αποστολους αλλ απηλθον εις αραβιαν και παλιν υπεστρεψα εις δαμασκον
kjv: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

vulg: deinde post annos tres veni Hierosolyma videre Petrum et mansi apud eum diebus quindecim
clem: deinde post annos tres veni Jerosolymam videre Petrum, et mansi apud eum diebus quindecim:
tr: επειτα μετα ετη τρια ανηλθον εις ιεροσολυμα ιστορησαι πετρον και επεμεινα προς αυτον ημερας δεκαπεντε
kjv: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

vulg: alium autem apostolorum vidi neminem nisi Iacobum fratrem Domini
clem: alium autem Apostolorum vidi neminem, nisi Jacobum fratrem Domini.
tr: ετερον δε των αποστολων ουκ ειδον ει μη ιακωβον τον αδελφον του κυριου
kjv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.

vulg: quae autem scribo vobis ecce coram Deo quia non mentior
clem: Qu autem scribo vobis, ecce coram Deo, quia non mentior.
tr: α δε γραφω υμιν ιδου ενωπιον του θεου οτι ου ψευδομαι
kjv: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

vulg: deinde veni in partes Syriae et Ciliciae
clem: Deinde veni in partes Syri, et Cilici.
tr: επειτα ηλθον εις τα κλιματα της συριας και της κιλικιας
kjv: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

vulg: eram autem ignotus facie ecclesiis Iudaeae quae erant in Christo
clem: Eram autem ignotus facie ecclesiis Jud, qu erant in Christo:
tr: ημην δε αγνοουμενος τω προσωπω ταις εκκλησιαις της ιουδαιας ταις εν χριστω
kjv: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:

vulg: tantum autem auditum habebant quoniam qui persequebatur nos aliquando nunc evangelizat fidem quam aliquando expugnabat
clem: tantum autem auditum habebant quoniam qui persequebatur nos aliquando, nunc evangelizat fidem, quam aliquando expugnabat:
tr: μονον δε ακουοντες ησαν οτι ο διωκων ημας ποτε νυν ευαγγελιζεται την πιστιν ην ποτε επορθει
kjv: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

vulg: et in me clarificabant Deum
clem: et in me clarificabant Deum.
tr: και εδοξαζον εν εμοι τον θεον
kjv: And they glorified God in me.

vulg: deinde post annos quattuordecim iterum ascendi Hierosolyma cum Barnaba adsumpto et Tito
clem: Deinde post annos quatuordecim, iterum ascendi Jerosolymam cum Barnaba, assumpto et Tito.
tr: επειτα δια δεκατεσσαρων ετων παλιν ανεβην εις ιεροσολυμα μετα βαρναβα συμπαραλαβων και τιτον
kjv: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

vulg: ascendi autem secundum revelationem et contuli cum illis evangelium quod praedico in gentibus seorsum autem his qui videbantur ne forte in vacuum currerem aut cucurrissem
clem: Ascendi autem secundum revelationem: et contuli cum illis Evangelium, quod prdico in gentibus, seorsum autem iis qui videbantur aliquid esse: ne forte in vacuum currerem, aut cucurrissem.
tr: ανεβην δε κατα αποκαλυψιν και ανεθεμην αυτοις το ευαγγελιον ο κηρυσσω εν τοις εθνεσιν κατ ιδιαν δε τοις δοκουσιν μηπως εις κενον τρεχω η εδραμον
kjv: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.

vulg: sed neque Titus qui mecum erat cum esset gentilis conpulsus est circumcidi
clem: Sed neque Titus, qui mecum erat, cum esset gentilis, compulsus est circumcidi:
tr: αλλ ουδε τιτος ο συν εμοι ελλην ων ηναγκασθη περιτμηθηναι
kjv: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

vulg: sed propter subintroductos falsos fratres qui subintroierunt explorare libertatem nostram quam habemus in Christo Iesu ut nos in servitutem redigerent
clem: sed propter subintroductos falsos fratres, qui subintroierunt explorare libertatem nostram, quam habemus in Christo Jesu, ut nos in servitutem redigerent.
tr: δια δε τους παρεισακτους ψευδαδελφους οιτινες παρεισηλθον κατασκοπησαι την ελευθεριαν ημων ην εχομεν εν χριστω ιησου ινα ημας καταδουλωσωνται
kjv: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

vulg: quibus neque ad horam cessimus subiectioni ut veritas evangelii permaneat apud vos
clem: Quibus neque ad horam cessimus subjectione, ut veritas Evangelii permaneat apud vos:
tr: οις ουδε προς ωραν ειξαμεν τη υποταγη ινα η αληθεια του ευαγγελιου διαμεινη προς υμας
kjv: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

vulg: ab his autem qui videbantur esse aliquid quales aliquando fuerint nihil mea interest Deus personam hominis non accipit mihi enim qui videbantur nihil contulerunt
clem: ab iis autem, qui videbantur esse aliquid (quales aliquando fuerint, nihil mea interest: Deus personam hominis non accipit): mihi enim qui videbantur esse aliquid, nihil contulerunt.
tr: απο δε των δοκουντων ειναι τι οποιοι ποτε ησαν ουδεν μοι διαφερει προσωπον θεος ανθρωπου ου λαμβανει εμοι γαρ οι δοκουντες ουδεν προσανεθεντο
kjv: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:

vulg: sed e contra cum vidissent quod creditum est mihi evangelium praeputii sicut Petro circumcisionis
clem: Sed e contra cum vidissent quod creditum est mihi Evangelium prputii, sicut et Petro circumcisionis
tr: αλλα τουναντιον ιδοντες οτι πεπιστευμαι το ευαγγελιον της ακροβυστιας καθως πετρος της περιτομης
kjv: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;

vulg: qui enim operatus est Petro in apostolatum circumcisionis operatus est et mihi inter gentes
clem: (qui enim operatus est Petro in apostolatum circumcisionis, operatus est et mihi inter gentes):
tr: ο γαρ ενεργησας πετρω εις αποστολην της περιτομης ενηργησεν και εμοι εις τα εθνη
kjv: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)

vulg: et cum cognovissent gratiam quae data est mihi Iacobus et Cephas et Iohannes qui videbantur columnae esse dextras dederunt mihi et Barnabae societatis ut nos in gentes ipsi autem in circumcisionem
clem: et cum cognovissent gratiam, qu data est mihi, Jacobus, et Cephas, et Joannes, qui videbantur column esse, dextras dederunt mihi, et Barnab societatis: ut nos in gentes, ipsi autem in circumcisionem:
tr: και γνοντες την χαριν την δοθεισαν μοι ιακωβος και κηφας και ιωαννης οι δοκουντες στυλοι ειναι δεξιας εδωκαν εμοι και βαρναβα κοινωνιας ινα ημεις εις τα εθνη αυτοι δε εις την περιτομην
kjv: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.

vulg: tantum ut pauperum memores essemus quod etiam sollicitus fui hoc ipsum facere
clem: tantum ut pauperum memores essemus, quod etiam sollicitus fui hoc ipsum facere.
tr: μονον των πτωχων ινα μνημονευωμεν ο και εσπουδασα αυτο τουτο ποιησαι
kjv: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

vulg: cum autem venisset Cephas Antiochiam in faciem ei restiti quia reprehensibilis erat
clem: Cum autem venisset Cephas Antiochiam, in faciem ei restiti, quia reprehensibilis erat.
tr: οτε δε ηλθεν πετρος εις αντιοχειαν κατα προσωπον αυτω αντεστην οτι κατεγνωσμενος ην
kjv: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

vulg: prius enim quam venirent quidam ab Iacobo cum gentibus edebat cum autem venissent subtrahebat et segregabat se timens eos qui ex circumcisione erant
clem: Prius enim quam venirent quidam a Jacobo, cum gentibus edebat: cum autem venissent, subtrahebat, et segregabat se, timens eos qui ex circumcisione erant.
tr: προ του γαρ ελθειν τινας απο ιακωβου μετα των εθνων συνησθιεν οτε δε ηλθον υπεστελλεν και αφωριζεν εαυτον φοβουμενος τους εκ περιτομης
kjv: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.

vulg: et simulationi eius consenserunt ceteri Iudaei ita ut et Barnabas duceretur ab eis in illa simulatione
clem: Et simulationi ejus consenserunt ceteri Judi, ita ut et Barnabas duceretur ab eis in illam simulationem.
tr: και συνυπεκριθησαν αυτω και οι λοιποι ιουδαιοι ωστε και βαρναβας συναπηχθη αυτων τη υποκρισει
kjv: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

vulg: sed cum vidissem quod non recte ambularent ad veritatem evangelii dixi Cephae coram omnibus si tu cum Iudaeus sis gentiliter et non iudaice vivis quomodo gentes cogis iudaizare
clem: Sed cum vidissem quod non recte ambularent ad veritatem Evangelii, dixi Ceph coram omnibus: Si tu, cum Judus sis, gentiliter vivis, et non judaice: quomodo gentes cogis judaizare?
tr: αλλ οτε ειδον οτι ουκ ορθοποδουσιν προς την αληθειαν του ευαγγελιου ειπον τω πετρω εμπροσθεν παντων ει συ ιουδαιος υπαρχων εθνικως ζης και ουκ ιουδαικως τι τα εθνη αναγκαζεις ιουδαιζειν
kjv: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

vulg: nos natura Iudaei et non ex gentibus peccatores
clem: Nos natura Judi, et non ex gentibus peccatores.
tr: ημεις φυσει ιουδαιοι και ουκ εξ εθνων αμαρτωλοι
kjv: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

vulg: scientes autem quod non iustificatur homo ex operibus legis nisi per fidem Iesu Christi et nos in Christo Iesu credidimus ut iustificemur ex fide Christi et non ex operibus legis propter quod ex operibus legis non iustificabitur omnis caro
clem: Scientes autem quod non justificatur homo ex operibus legis, nisi per fidem Jesu Christi: et nos in Christo Jesu credimus, ut justificemur ex fide Christi, et non ex operibus legis: propter quod ex operibus legis non justificabitur omnis caro.
tr: ειδοτες οτι ου δικαιουται ανθρωπος εξ εργων νομου εαν μη δια πιστεως ιησου χριστου και ημεις εις χριστον ιησουν επιστευσαμεν ινα δικαιωθωμεν εκ πιστεως χριστου και ουκ εξ εργων νομου διοτι ου δικαιωθησεται εξ εργων νομου πασα σαρξ
kjv: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

vulg: quod si quaerentes iustificari in Christo inventi sumus et ipsi peccatores numquid Christus peccati minister est absit
clem: Quod si qurentes justificari in Christo, inventi sumus et ipsi peccatores, numquid Christus peccati minister est? Absit.
tr: ει δε ζητουντες δικαιωθηναι εν χριστω ευρεθημεν και αυτοι αμαρτωλοι αρα χριστος αμαρτιας διακονος μη γενοιτο
kjv: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.

vulg: si enim quae destruxi haec iterum aedifico praevaricatorem me constituo
clem: Si enim qu destruxi, iterum hc difico: prvaricatorem me constituo.
tr: ει γαρ α κατελυσα ταυτα παλιν οικοδομω παραβατην εμαυτον συνιστημι
kjv: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

vulg: ego enim per legem legi mortuus sum ut Deo vivam Christo confixus sum cruci
clem: Ego enim per legem, legi mortuus sum, ut Deo vivam: Christo confixus sum cruci.
tr: εγω γαρ δια νομου νομω απεθανον ινα θεω ζησω
kjv: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.

vulg: vivo autem iam non ego vivit vero in me Christus quod autem nunc vivo in carne in fide vivo Filii Dei qui dilexit me et tradidit se ipsum pro me
clem: Vivo autem, jam non ego: vivit vero in me Christus. Quod autem nunc vivo in carne: in fide vivo Filii Dei, qui dilexit me, et tradidit semetipsum pro me.
tr: χριστω συνεσταυρωμαι ζω δε ουκετι εγω ζη δε εν εμοι χριστος ο δε νυν ζω εν σαρκι εν πιστει ζω τη του υιου του θεου του αγαπησαντος με και παραδοντος εαυτον υπερ εμου
kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

vulg: non abicio gratiam Dei si enim per legem iustitia ergo Christus gratis mortuus est
clem: Non abjicio gratiam Dei. Si enim per legem justitia, ergo gratis Christus mortuus est.
tr: ουκ αθετω την χαριν του θεου ει γαρ δια νομου δικαιοσυνη αρα χριστος δωρεαν απεθανεν
kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.

vulg: o insensati Galatae quis vos fascinavit ante quorum oculos Iesus Christus proscriptus est crucifixus
clem: O insensati Galat, quis vos fascinavit non obedire veritati, ante quorum oculos Jesus Christus prscriptus est, in vobis crucifixus?
tr: ω ανοητοι γαλαται τις υμας εβασκανεν τη αληθεια μη πειθεσθαι οις κατ οφθαλμους ιησους χριστος προεγραφη εν υμιν εσταυρωμενος
kjv: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

vulg: hoc solum volo a vobis discere ex operibus legis Spiritum accepistis an ex auditu fidei
clem: Hoc solum a vobis volo discere: ex operibus legis Spiritum accepistis, an ex auditu fidei?
tr: τουτο μονον θελω μαθειν αφ υμων εξ εργων νομου το πνευμα ελαβετε η εξ ακοης πιστεως
kjv: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

vulg: sic stulti estis cum Spiritu coeperitis nunc carne consummamini
clem: sic stulti estis, ut cum Spiritu cperitis, nunc carne consummemini?
tr: ουτως ανοητοι εστε εναρξαμενοι πνευματι νυν σαρκι επιτελεισθε
kjv: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

vulg: tanta passi estis sine causa si tamen sine causa
clem: tanta passi estis sine causa? si tamen sine causa.
tr: τοσαυτα επαθετε εικη ειγε και εικη
kjv: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

vulg: qui ergo tribuit vobis Spiritum et operatur virtutes in vobis ex operibus legis an ex auditu fidei
clem: Qui ergo tribuit vobis Spiritum, et operatur virtutes in vobis: ex operibus legis, an ex auditu fidei?
tr: ο ουν επιχορηγων υμιν το πνευμα και ενεργων δυναμεις εν υμιν εξ εργων νομου η εξ ακοης πιστεως
kjv: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

vulg: sicut Abraham credidit Deo et reputatum est ei ad iustitiam
clem: Sicut scriptum est: Abraham credidit Deo, et reputatum est illi ad justitiam:
tr: καθως αβρααμ επιστευσεν τω θεω και ελογισθη αυτω εις δικαιοσυνην
kjv: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

vulg: cognoscitis ergo quia qui ex fide sunt hii sunt filii Abrahae
clem: cognoscite ergo quia qui ex fide sunt, ii sunt filii Abrah.
tr: γινωσκετε  αρα οτι οι εκ πιστεως ουτοι εισιν υιοι αβρααμ
kjv: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

vulg: providens autem scriptura quia ex fide iustificat gentes Deus praenuntiavit Abrahae quia benedicentur in te omnes gentes
clem: Providens autem Scriptura quia ex fide justificat gentes Deus, prnuntiavit Abrah: Quia benedicentur in te omnes gentes.
tr: προιδουσα δε η γραφη οτι εκ πιστεως δικαιοι τα εθνη ο θεος προευηγγελισατο τω αβρααμ οτι ενευλογηθησονται  ευλογηθησονται  εν σοι παντα τα εθνη
kjv: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

vulg: igitur qui ex fide sunt benedicentur cum fideli Abraham
clem: Igitur qui ex fide sunt, benedicentur cum fideli Abraham.
tr: ωστε οι εκ πιστεως ευλογουνται συν τω πιστω αβρααμ
kjv: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

vulg: quicumque enim ex operibus legis sunt sub maledicto sunt scriptum est enim maledictus omnis qui non permanserit in omnibus quae scripta sunt in libro legis ut faciat ea
clem: Quicumque enim ex operibus legis sunt, sub maledicto sunt. Scriptum est enim: Maledictus omnis qui non permanserit in omnibus qu scripta sunt in libro legis ut faciat ea.
tr: οσοι γαρ εξ εργων νομου εισιν υπο καταραν εισιν γεγραπται γαρ επικαταρατος πας ος ουκ εμμενει εν πασιν τοις γεγραμμενοις εν τω βιβλιω του νομου του ποιησαι αυτα
kjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

vulg: quoniam autem in lege nemo iustificatur apud Deum manifestum est quia iustus ex fide vivit
clem: Quoniam autem in lege nemo justificatur apud Deum, manifestum est: quia justus ex fide vivit.
tr: οτι δε εν νομω ουδεις δικαιουται παρα τω θεω δηλον οτι ο δικαιος εκ πιστεως ζησεται
kjv: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

vulg: lex autem non est ex fide sed qui fecerit ea vivet in illis
clem: Lex autem non est ex fide, sed: Qui fecerit ea, vivet in illis.
tr: ο δε νομος ουκ εστιν εκ πιστεως αλλ ο ποιησας αυτα ανθρωπος ζησεται εν αυτοις
kjv: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.

vulg: Christus nos redemit de maledicto legis factus pro nobis maledictum quia scriptum est maledictus omnis qui pendet in ligno
clem: Christus nos redemit de maledicto legis, factus pro nobis maledictum: quia scriptum est: Maledictus omnis qui pendet in ligno:
tr: χριστος ημας εξηγορασεν εκ της καταρας του νομου γενομενος υπερ ημων καταρα γεγραπται γαρ επικαταρατος πας ο κρεμαμενος επι ξυλου
kjv: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

vulg: ut in gentibus benedictio Abrahae fieret in Christo Iesu ut pollicitationem Spiritus accipiamus per fidem
clem: ut in gentibus benedictio Abrah fieret in Christo Jesu, ut pollicitationem Spiritus accipiamus per fidem.
tr: ινα εις τα εθνη η ευλογια του αβρααμ γενηται εν χριστω ιησου ινα την επαγγελιαν του πνευματος λαβωμεν δια της πιστεως
kjv: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

vulg: fratres secundum hominem dico tamen hominis confirmatum testamentum nemo spernit aut superordinat
clem: Fratres (secundum hominem dico) tamen hominis confirmatum testamentum nemo spernit, aut superordinat.
tr: αδελφοι κατα ανθρωπον λεγω ομως ανθρωπου κεκυρωμενην διαθηκην ουδεις αθετει η επιδιατασσεται
kjv: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.

vulg: Abrahae dictae sunt promissiones et semini eius non dicit et seminibus quasi in multis sed quasi in uno et semini tuo qui est Christus
clem: Abrah dict sunt promissiones, et semini ejus. Non dicit: Et seminibus, quasi in multis: sed quasi in uno: Et semini tuo, qui est Christus.
tr: τω δε αβρααμ ερρηθησαν αι επαγγελιαι και τω σπερματι αυτου ου λεγει και τοις σπερμασιν ως επι πολλων αλλ ως εφ ενος και τω σπερματι σου ος εστιν χριστος
kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

vulg: hoc autem dico testamentum confirmatum a Deo quae post quadringentos et triginta annos facta est lex non irritam facit ad evacuandam promissionem
clem: Hoc autem dico, testamentum confirmatum a Deo: qu post quadringentos et triginta annos facta est lex, non irritum facit ad evacuandam promissionem.
tr: τουτο δε λεγω διαθηκην προκεκυρωμενην υπο του θεου εις χριστον ο μετα ετη τετρακοσια και τριακοντα γεγονως νομος ουκ ακυροι εις το καταργησαι την επαγγελιαν
kjv: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

vulg: nam si ex lege hereditas iam non ex repromissione Abrahae autem per promissionem donavit Deus
clem: Nam si ex lege hreditas, jam non ex promissione. Abrah autem per repromissionem donavit Deus.
tr: ει γαρ εκ νομου η κληρονομια ουκετι εξ επαγγελιας τω δε αβρααμ δι επαγγελιας κεχαρισται ο θεος
kjv: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.

vulg: quid igitur lex propter transgressiones posita est donec veniret semen cui promiserat ordinata per angelos in manu mediatoris
clem: Quid igitur lex? Propter transgressiones posita est donec veniret semen, cui promiserat, ordinata per angelos in manu mediatoris.
tr: τι ουν ο νομος των παραβασεων χαριν προσετεθη αχρις ου ελθη το σπερμα ω επηγγελται διαταγεις δι αγγελων εν χειρι μεσιτου
kjv: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

vulg: mediator autem unius non est Deus autem unus est
clem: Mediator autem unius non est: Deus autem unus est.
tr: ο δε μεσιτης ενος ουκ εστιν ο δε θεος εις εστιν
kjv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

vulg: lex ergo adversus promissa Dei absit si enim data esset lex quae posset vivificare vere ex lege esset iustitia
clem: Lex ergo adversus promissa Dei? Absit. Si enim data esset lex, qu posset vivificare, vere ex lege esset justitia.
tr: ο ουν νομος κατα των επαγγελιων του θεου μη γενοιτο ει γαρ εδοθη νομος ο δυναμενος ζωοποιησαι οντως αν εκ νομου ην η δικαιοσυνη
kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

vulg: sed conclusit scriptura omnia sub peccato ut promissio ex fide Iesu Christi daretur credentibus
clem: Sed conclusit Scriptura omnia sub peccato, ut promissio ex fide Jesu Christi daretur credentibus.
tr: αλλα συνεκλεισεν η γραφη τα παντα υπο αμαρτιαν ινα η επαγγελια εκ πιστεως ιησου χριστου δοθη τοις πιστευουσιν
kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

vulg: prius autem quam veniret fides sub lege custodiebamur conclusi in eam fidem quae revelanda erat
clem: Prius autem quam veniret fides, sub lege custodiebamur conclusi in eam fidem qu revelanda erat.
tr: προ του δε ελθειν την πιστιν υπο νομον εφρουρουμεθα συγκεκλεισμενοι εις την μελλουσαν πιστιν αποκαλυφθηναι
kjv: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

vulg: itaque lex pedagogus noster fuit in Christo ut ex fide iustificemur
clem: Itaque lex pdagogus noster fuit in Christo, ut ex fide justificemur.
tr: ωστε ο νομος παιδαγωγος ημων γεγονεν εις χριστον ινα εκ πιστεως δικαιωθωμεν
kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

vulg: at ubi venit fides iam non sumus sub pedagogo
clem: At ubi venit fides, jam non sumus sub pdagogo.
tr: ελθουσης δε της πιστεως ουκετι υπο παιδαγωγον εσμεν
kjv: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

vulg: omnes enim filii Dei estis per fidem in Christo Iesu
clem: Omnes enim filii Dei estis per fidem, qu est in Christo Jesu.
tr: παντες γαρ υιοι θεου εστε δια της πιστεως εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

vulg: quicumque enim in Christo baptizati estis Christum induistis
clem: Quicumque enim in Christo baptizati estis, Christum induistis.
tr: οσοι γαρ εις χριστον εβαπτισθητε χριστον ενεδυσασθε
kjv: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

vulg: non est Iudaeus neque Graecus non est servus neque liber non est masculus neque femina omnes enim vos unum estis in Christo Iesu
clem: Non est Judus, neque Grcus: non est servus, neque liber: non est masculus, neque femina. Omnes enim vos unum estis in Christo Jesu.
tr: ουκ ενι ιουδαιος ουδε ελλην ουκ ενι δουλος ουδε ελευθερος ουκ ενι αρσεν και θηλυ παντες γαρ υμεις εις εστε εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

vulg: si autem vos Christi ergo Abrahae semen estis secundum promissionem heredes
clem: Si autem vos Christi, ergo semen Abrah estis, secundum promissionem hredes.
tr: ει δε υμεις χριστου αρα του αβρααμ σπερμα εστε και κατ επαγγελιαν κληρονομοι
kjv: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

vulg: dico autem quanto tempore heres parvulus est nihil differt servo cum sit dominus omnium
clem: Dico autem: quanto tempore hres parvulus est, nihil differt a servo, cum sit dominus omnium:
tr: λεγω δε εφ οσον χρονον ο κληρονομος νηπιος εστιν ουδεν διαφερει δουλου κυριος παντων ων
kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

vulg: sed sub tutoribus est et actoribus usque ad praefinitum tempus a patre
clem: sed sub tutoribus et actoribus est usque ad prfinitum tempus a patre:
tr: αλλα υπο επιτροπους εστιν και οικονομους αχρι της προθεσμιας του πατρος
kjv: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

vulg: ita et nos cum essemus parvuli sub elementis mundi eramus servientes
clem: ita et nos cum essemus parvuli, sub elementis mundi eramus servientes.
tr: ουτως και ημεις οτε ημεν νηπιοι υπο τα στοιχεια του κοσμου ημεν δεδουλωμενοι
kjv: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

vulg: at ubi venit plenitudo temporis misit Deus Filium suum factum ex muliere factum sub lege
clem: At ubi venit plenitudo temporis, misit Deus Filium suum factum ex muliere, factum sub lege,
tr: οτε δε ηλθεν το πληρωμα του χρονου εξαπεστειλεν ο θεος τον υιον αυτου γενομενον εκ γυναικος γενομενον υπο νομον
kjv: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

vulg: ut eos qui sub lege erant redimeret ut adoptionem filiorum reciperemus
clem: ut eos, qui sub lege erant, redimeret, ut adoptionem filiorum reciperemus.
tr: ινα τους υπο νομον εξαγοραση ινα την υιοθεσιαν απολαβωμεν
kjv: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

vulg: quoniam autem estis filii misit Deus Spiritum Filii sui in corda nostra clamantem Abba Pater
clem: Quoniam autem estis filii, misit Deus Spiritum Filii sui in corda vestra, clamantem: Abba, Pater.
tr: οτι δε εστε υιοι εξαπεστειλεν ο θεος το πνευμα του υιου αυτου εις τας καρδιας υμων κραζον αββα ο πατηρ
kjv: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

vulg: itaque iam non es servus sed filius quod si filius et heres per Deum
clem: Itaque jam non est servus, sed filius: quod si filius, et hres per Deum.
tr: ωστε ουκετι ει δουλος αλλ υιος ει δε υιος και κληρονομος θεου δια χριστου
kjv: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

vulg: sed tunc quidem ignorantes Deum his qui natura non sunt dii serviebatis
clem: Sed tunc quidem ignorantes Deum, iis, qui natura non sunt dii, serviebatis.
tr: αλλα τοτε μεν ουκ ειδοτες θεον εδουλευσατε τοις μη φυσει ουσιν θεοις
kjv: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

vulg: nunc autem cum cognoveritis Deum immo cogniti sitis a Deo quomodo convertimini iterum ad infirma et egena elementa quibus denuo servire vultis
clem: Nunc autem cum cognoveritis Deum, immo cogniti sitis a Deo: quomodo convertimini iterum ad infirma et egena elementa, quibus denuo servire vultis?
tr: νυν δε γνοντες θεον μαλλον δε γνωσθεντες υπο θεου πως επιστρεφετε παλιν επι τα ασθενη και πτωχα στοιχεια οις παλιν ανωθεν δουλευειν θελετε
kjv: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

vulg: dies observatis et menses et tempora et annos
clem: Dies observatis, et menses, et tempora, et annos.
tr: ημερας παρατηρεισθε και μηνας και καιρους και ενιαυτους
kjv: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

vulg: timeo vos ne forte sine causa laboraverim in vobis
clem: Timeo vos, ne forte sine causa laboraverim in vobis.
tr: φοβουμαι υμας μηπως εικη κεκοπιακα εις υμας
kjv: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

vulg: estote sicut et ego quia et ego sicut vos fratres obsecro vos nihil me laesistis
clem: Estote sicut ego, quia et ego sicut vos: fratres, obsecro vos. Nihil me lsistis.
tr: γινεσθε ως εγω οτι καγω ως υμεις αδελφοι δεομαι υμων ουδεν με ηδικησατε
kjv: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.

vulg: scitis autem quia per infirmitatem carnis evangelizavi vobis iam pridem
clem: Scitis autem quia per infirmitatem carnis evangelizavi vobis jampridem: et tentationem vestram in carne mea
tr: οιδατε δε οτι δι ασθενειαν της σαρκος ευηγγελισαμην υμιν το προτερον
kjv: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

vulg: et temptationem vestram in carne mea non sprevistis neque respuistis sed sicut angelum Dei excepistis me sicut Christum Iesum
clem: non sprevistis, neque respuistis: sed sicut angelum Dei excepistis me, sicut Christum Jesum.
tr: και τον πειρασμον μου τον εν τη σαρκι μου ουκ εξουθενησατε ουδε εξεπτυσατε αλλ ως αγγελον θεου εδεξασθε με ως χριστον ιησουν
kjv: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

vulg: ubi est ergo beatitudo vestra testimonium enim perhibeo vobis quia si fieri posset oculos vestros eruissetis et dedissetis mihi
clem: Ubi est ergo beatitudo vestra? testimonium enim perhibeo vobis, quia, si fieri posset, oculos vestros eruissetis, et dedissetis mihi.
tr: τις ουν ην ο μακαρισμος υμων μαρτυρω γαρ υμιν οτι ει δυνατον τους οφθαλμους υμων εξορυξαντες αν εδωκατε μοι
kjv: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

vulg: ergo inimicus vobis factus sum verum dicens vobis
clem: Ergo inimicus vobis factus sum, verum dicens vobis?
tr: ωστε εχθρος υμων γεγονα αληθευων υμιν
kjv: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

vulg: aemulantur vos non bene sed excludere vos volunt ut illos aemulemini
clem: mulantur vos non bene: sed excludere vos volunt, ut illos mulemini.
tr: ζηλουσιν υμας ου καλως αλλα εκκλεισαι υμας θελουσιν ινα αυτους ζηλουτε
kjv: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

vulg: bonum autem aemulamini in bono semper et non tantum cum praesens sum apud vos
clem: Bonum autem mulamini in bono semper: et non tantum cum prsens sum apud vos.
tr: καλον δε το ζηλουσθαι εν καλω παντοτε και μη μονον εν τω παρειναι με προς υμας
kjv: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

vulg: filioli mei quos iterum parturio donec formetur Christus in vobis
clem: Filioli mei, quos iterum parturio, donec formetur Christus in vobis:
tr: τεκνια μου ους παλιν ωδινω αχρις ου μορφωθη χριστος εν υμιν
kjv: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

vulg: vellem autem esse apud vos modo et mutare vocem meam quoniam confundor in vobis
clem: vellem autem esse apud vos modo, et mutare vocem meam: quoniam confundor in vobis.
tr: ηθελον δε παρειναι προς υμας αρτι και αλλαξαι την φωνην μου οτι απορουμαι εν υμιν
kjv: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

vulg: dicite mihi qui sub lege vultis esse legem non legistis
clem: Dicite mihi qui sub lege vultis esse: legem non legistis?
tr: λεγετε μοι οι υπο νομον θελοντες ειναι τον νομον ουκ ακουετε
kjv: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

vulg: scriptum est enim quoniam Abraham duos filios habuit unum de ancilla et unum de libera
clem: Scriptum est enim: Quoniam Abraham duos filios habuit: unum de ancilla, et unum de libera.
tr: γεγραπται γαρ οτι αβρααμ δυο υιους εσχεν ενα εκ της παιδισκης και ενα εκ της ελευθερας
kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

vulg: sed qui de ancilla secundum carnem natus est qui autem de libera per repromissionem
clem: Sed qui de ancilla, secundum carnem natus est: qui autem de libera, per repromissionem:
tr: αλλ ο μεν εκ της παιδισκης κατα σαρκα γεγεννηται ο δε εκ της ελευθερας δια της επαγγελιας
kjv: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

vulg: quae sunt per allegoriam dicta haec enim sunt duo testamenta unum quidem a monte Sina in servitutem generans quae est Agar
clem: qu sunt per allegoriam dicta. Hc enim sunt duo testamenta. Unum quidem in monte Sina, in servitutem generans, qu est Agar:
tr: ατινα εστιν αλληγορουμενα αυται γαρ εισιν αι δυο διαθηκαι μια μεν απο ορους σινα εις δουλειαν γεννωσα ητις εστιν αγαρ
kjv: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

vulg: Sina enim mons est in Arabia qui coniunctus est ei quae nunc est Hierusalem et servit cum filiis eius
clem: Sina enim mons est in Arabia, qui conjunctus est ei qu nunc est Jerusalem, et servit cum filiis suis.
tr: το γαρ αγαρ σινα ορος εστιν εν τη αραβια συστοιχει δε τη νυν ιερουσαλημ δουλευει δε μετα των τεκνων αυτης
kjv: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

vulg: illa autem quae sursum est Hierusalem libera est quae est mater nostra
clem: Illa autem, qu sursum est Jerusalem, libera est, qu est mater nostra.
tr: η δε ανω ιερουσαλημ ελευθερα εστιν ητις εστιν μητηρ παντων ημων
kjv: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

vulg: scriptum est enim laetare sterilis quae non paris erumpe et exclama quae non parturis quia multi filii desertae magis quam eius quae habet virum
clem: Scriptum est enim: [Ltare sterilis, qu non paris; erumpe et clama, qu non parturis: quia multi filii desert, magis quam ejus qu habet virum.]
tr: γεγραπται γαρ ευφρανθητι στειρα η ου τικτουσα ρηξον και βοησον η ουκ ωδινουσα οτι πολλα τα τεκνα της ερημου μαλλον η της εχουσης τον ανδρα
kjv: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

vulg: nos autem fratres secundum Isaac promissionis filii sumus
clem: Nos autem, fratres, secundum Isaac promissionis filii sumus.
tr: ημεις δε αδελφοι κατα ισαακ επαγγελιας τεκνα εσμεν
kjv: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

vulg: sed quomodo tunc qui secundum carnem natus fuerat persequebatur eum qui secundum spiritum ita et nunc
clem: Sed quomodo tunc is, qui secundum carnem natus fuerat, persequebatur eum qui secundum spiritum: ita et nunc.
tr: αλλ ωσπερ τοτε ο κατα σαρκα γεννηθεις εδιωκεν τον κατα πνευμα ουτως και νυν
kjv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

vulg: sed quid dicit scriptura eice ancillam et filium eius non enim heres erit filius ancillae cum filio liberae
clem: Sed quid dicit Scriptura? Ejice ancillam, et filium ejus: non enim hres erit filius ancill cum filio liber.
tr: αλλα τι λεγει η γραφη εκβαλε την παιδισκην και τον υιον αυτης ου γαρ μη κληρονομηση ο υιος της παιδισκης μετα του υιου της ελευθερας
kjv: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

vulg: itaque fratres non sumus ancillae filii sed liberae qua libertate nos Christus liberavit
clem: Itaque, fratres, non sumus ancill filii, sed liber: qua libertate Christus nos liberavit.
tr: αρα αδελφοι ουκ εσμεν παιδισκης τεκνα αλλα της ελευθερας
kjv: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

vulg: state et nolite iterum iugo servitutis contineri
clem: State, et nolite iterum jugo servitutis contineri.
tr: τη ελευθερια ουν η χριστος ημας ηλευθερωσεν στηκετε και μη παλιν ζυγω δουλειας ενεχεσθε
kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

vulg: ecce ego Paulus dico vobis quoniam si circumcidamini Christus vobis nihil proderit
clem: Ecce ego Paulus dico vobis: quoniam si circumcidamini, Christus vobis nihil proderit.
tr: ιδε εγω παυλος λεγω υμιν οτι εαν περιτεμνησθε χριστος υμας ουδεν ωφελησει
kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

vulg: testificor autem rursum omni homini circumcidenti se quoniam debitor est universae legis faciendae
clem: Testificor autem rursus omni homini circumcidenti se, quoniam debitor est univers legis faciend.
tr: μαρτυρομαι δε παλιν παντι ανθρωπω περιτεμνομενω οτι οφειλετης εστιν ολον τον νομον ποιησαι
kjv: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

vulg: evacuati estis a Christo qui in lege iustificamini a gratia excidistis
clem: Evacuati estis a Christo, qui in lege justificamini: a gratia excidistis.
tr: κατηργηθητε απο του χριστου οιτινες εν νομω δικαιουσθε της χαριτος εξεπεσατε
kjv: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

vulg: nos enim spiritu ex fide spem iustitiae expectamus
clem: Nos enim spiritu ex fide, spem justiti exspectamus.
tr: ημεις γαρ πνευματι εκ πιστεως ελπιδα δικαιοσυνης απεκδεχομεθα
kjv: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

vulg: nam in Christo Iesu neque circumcisio aliquid valet neque praeputium sed fides quae per caritatem operatur
clem: Nam in Christo Jesu neque circumcisio aliquid valet, neque prputium: sed fides, qu per caritatem operatur.
tr: εν γαρ χριστω ιησου ουτε περιτομη τι ισχυει ουτε ακροβυστια αλλα πιστις δι αγαπης ενεργουμενη
kjv: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

vulg: currebatis bene quis vos inpedivit veritati non oboedire
clem: Currebatis bene: quis vos impedivit veritati non obedire?
tr: ετρεχετε καλως τις υμας ανεκοψεν τη αληθεια μη πειθεσθαι
kjv: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

vulg: persuasio non est ex eo qui vocat vos
clem: persuasio hc non est ex eo, qui vocat vos.
tr: η πεισμονη ουκ εκ του καλουντος υμας
kjv: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

vulg: modicum fermentum totam massam corrumpit
clem: Modicum fermentum totam massam corrumpit.
tr: μικρα ζυμη ολον το φυραμα ζυμοι
kjv: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

vulg: ego confido in vobis in Domino quod nihil aliud sapietis qui autem conturbat vos portabit iudicium quicumque est ille
clem: Ego confido in vobis in Domino, quod nihil aliud sapietis: qui autem conturbat vos, portabit judicium, quicumque est ille.
tr: εγω πεποιθα εις υμας εν κυριω οτι ουδεν αλλο φρονησετε ο δε ταρασσων υμας βαστασει το κριμα οστις αν η
kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

vulg: ego autem fratres si circumcisionem adhuc praedico quid adhuc persecutionem patior ergo evacuatum est scandalum crucis
clem: Ego autem, fratres, si circumcisionem adhuc prdico: quid adhuc persecutionem patior? ergo evacuatum est scandalum crucis.
tr: εγω δε αδελφοι ει περιτομην ετι κηρυσσω τι ετι διωκομαι αρα κατηργηται το σκανδαλον του σταυρου
kjv: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

vulg: utinam et abscidantur qui vos conturbant
clem: Utinam et abscindantur qui vos conturbant.
tr: οφελον και αποκοψονται οι αναστατουντες υμας
kjv: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

vulg: vos enim in libertatem vocati estis fratres tantum ne libertatem in occasionem detis carnis sed per caritatem servite invicem
clem: Vos enim in libertatem vocati estis, fratres: tantum ne libertatem in occasionem detis carnis, sed per caritatem Spiritus servite invicem.
tr: υμεις γαρ επ ελευθερια εκληθητε αδελφοι μονον μη την ελευθεριαν εις αφορμην τη σαρκι αλλα δια της αγαπης δουλευετε αλληλοις
kjv: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

vulg: omnis enim lex in uno sermone impletur diliges proximum tuum sicut te ipsum
clem: Omnis enim lex in uno sermone impletur: Diliges proximum tuum sicut teipsum.
tr: ο γαρ πας νομος εν ενι λογω πληρουται εν τω αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου ως εαυτον
kjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

vulg: quod si invicem mordetis et comeditis videte ne ab invicem consumamini
clem: Quod si invicem mordetis, et comeditis: videte ne ab invicem consumamini.
tr: ει δε αλληλους δακνετε και κατεσθιετε βλεπετε μη υπο αλληλων αναλωθητε
kjv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

vulg: dico autem spiritu ambulate et desiderium carnis non perficietis
clem: Dico autem: Spiritu ambulate, et desideria carnis non perficietis.
tr: λεγω δε πνευματι περιπατειτε και επιθυμιαν σαρκος ου μη τελεσητε
kjv: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

vulg: caro enim concupiscit adversus spiritum spiritus autem adversus carnem haec enim invicem adversantur ut non quaecumque vultis illa faciatis
clem: Caro enim concupiscit adversus spiritum, spiritus autem adversus carnem: hc enim sibi invicem adversantur, ut non qucumque vultis, illa faciatis.
tr: η γαρ σαρξ επιθυμει κατα του πνευματος το δε πνευμα κατα της σαρκος ταυτα δε αντικειται αλληλοις ινα μη α αν θελητε ταυτα ποιητε
kjv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

vulg: quod si spiritu ducimini non estis sub lege
clem: Quod si Spiritu ducimini, non estis sub lege.
tr: ει δε πνευματι αγεσθε ουκ εστε υπο νομον
kjv: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

vulg: manifesta autem sunt opera carnis quae sunt fornicatio inmunditia luxuria
clem: Manifesta sunt autem opera carnis, qu sunt fornicatio, immunditia, impudicitia, luxuria,
tr: φανερα δε εστιν τα εργα της σαρκος ατινα εστιν μοιχεια πορνεια ακαθαρσια ασελγεια
kjv: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

vulg: idolorum servitus veneficia inimicitiae contentiones aemulationes irae rixae dissensiones sectae
clem: idolorum servitus, veneficia, inimiciti, contentiones, mulationes, ir, rix, dissensiones, sect,
tr: ειδωλολατρεια φαρμακεια εχθραι ερεις ζηλοι θυμοι εριθειαι διχοστασιαι αιρεσεις
kjv: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

vulg: invidiae homicidia ebrietates comesationes et his similia quae praedico vobis sicut praedixi quoniam qui talia agunt regnum Dei non consequentur
clem: invidi, homicidia, ebrietates, comessationes, et his similia, qu prdico vobis, sicut prdixi: quoniam qui talia agunt, regnum Dei non consequentur.
tr: φθονοι φονοι μεθαι κωμοι και τα ομοια τουτοις α προλεγω υμιν καθως και προειπον οτι οι τα τοιαυτα πρασσοντες βασιλειαν θεου ου κληρονομησουσιν
kjv: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

vulg: fructus autem Spiritus est caritas gaudium pax longanimitas bonitas benignitas
clem: Fructus autem Spiritus est caritas, gaudium, pax, patientia, benignitas, bonitas, longanimitas,
tr: ο δε καρπος του πνευματος εστιν αγαπη χαρα ειρηνη μακροθυμια χρηστοτης αγαθωσυνη πιστις
kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

vulg: fides modestia continentia adversus huiusmodi non est lex
clem: mansuetudo, fides, modestia, continentia, castitas. Adversus hujusmodi non est lex.
tr: πραοτης εγκρατεια κατα των τοιουτων ουκ εστιν νομος
kjv: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

vulg: qui autem sunt Christi carnem crucifixerunt cum vitiis et concupiscentiis
clem: Qui autem sunt Christi, carnem suam crucifixerunt cum vitiis et concupiscentiis.
tr: οι δε του χριστου την σαρκα εσταυρωσαν συν τοις παθημασιν και ταις επιθυμιαις
kjv: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

vulg: si vivimus spiritu spiritu et ambulemus
clem: Si Spiritu vivimus, Spiritu et ambulemus.
tr: ει ζωμεν πνευματι πνευματι και στοιχωμεν
kjv: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

vulg: non efficiamur inanis gloriae cupidi invicem provocantes invicem invidentes
clem: Non efficiamur inanis glori cupidi, invicem provocantes, invicem invidentes.
tr: μη γινωμεθα κενοδοξοι αλληλους προκαλουμενοι αλληλοις φθονουντες
kjv: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

vulg: fratres et si praeoccupatus fuerit homo in aliquo delicto vos qui spiritales estis huiusmodi instruite in spiritu lenitatis considerans te ipsum ne et tu tempteris
clem: Fratres, etsi proccupatus fuerit homo in aliquo delicto, vos, qui spirituales estis, hujusmodi instruite in spiritu lenitatis, considerans teipsum, ne et tu tenteris.
tr: αδελφοι εαν και προληφθη ανθρωπος εν τινι παραπτωματι υμεις οι πνευματικοι καταρτιζετε τον τοιουτον εν πνευματι πραοτητος σκοπων σεαυτον μη και συ πειρασθης
kjv: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

vulg: alter alterius onera portate et sic adimplebitis legem Christi
clem: Alter alterius onera portate, et sic adimplebitis legem Christi.
tr: αλληλων τα βαρη βασταζετε και ουτως αναπληρωσατε τον νομον του χριστου
kjv: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

vulg: nam si quis existimat se aliquid esse cum sit nihil ipse se seducit
clem: Nam si quis existimat se aliquid esse, cum nihil sit, ipse se seducit.
tr: ει γαρ δοκει τις ειναι τι μηδεν ων εαυτον φρεναπατα
kjv: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

vulg: opus autem suum probet unusquisque et sic in semet ipso tantum gloriam habebit et non in altero
clem: Opus autem suum probet unusquisque, et sic in semetipso tantum gloriam habebit, et non in altero.
tr: το δε εργον εαυτου δοκιμαζετω εκαστος και τοτε εις εαυτον μονον το καυχημα εξει και ουκ εις τον ετερον
kjv: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

vulg: unusquisque enim onus suum portabit
clem: Unusquisque enim onus suum portabit.
tr: εκαστος γαρ το ιδιον φορτιον βαστασει
kjv: For every man shall bear his own burden.

vulg: communicet autem is qui catecizatur verbum ei qui se catecizat in omnibus bonis
clem: Communicet autem is qui catechizatur verbo, ei qui se catechizat, in omnibus bonis.
tr: κοινωνειτω δε ο κατηχουμενος τον λογον τω κατηχουντι εν πασιν αγαθοις
kjv: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

vulg: nolite errare Deus non inridetur
clem: Nolite errare: Deus non irridetur.
tr: μη πλανασθε θεος ου μυκτηριζεται ο γαρ εαν σπειρη ανθρωπος τουτο και θερισει
kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

vulg: quae enim seminaverit homo haec et metet quoniam qui seminat in carne sua de carne et metet corruptionem qui autem seminat in spiritu de spiritu metet vitam aeternam
clem: Qu enim seminaverit homo, hc et metet. Quoniam qui seminat in carne sua, de carne et metet corruptionem: qui autem seminat in spiritu, de spiritu metet vitam ternam.
tr: οτι ο σπειρων εις την σαρκα εαυτου εκ της σαρκος θερισει φθοραν ο δε σπειρων εις το πνευμα εκ του πνευματος θερισει ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

vulg: bonum autem facientes non deficiamus tempore enim suo metemus non deficientes
clem: Bonum autem facientes, non deficiamus: tempore enim suo metemus non deficientes.
tr: το δε καλον ποιουντες μη εκκακωμεν καιρω γαρ ιδιω θερισομεν μη εκλυομενοι
kjv: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

vulg: ergo dum tempus habemus operemur bonum ad omnes maxime autem ad domesticos fidei
clem: Ergo dum tempus habemus, operemur bonum ad omnes, maxime autem ad domesticos fidei.
tr: αρα ουν ως καιρον εχομεν εργαζωμεθα το αγαθον προς παντας μαλιστα δε προς τους οικειους της πιστεως
kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

vulg: videte qualibus litteris scripsi vobis mea manu
clem: Videte qualibus litteris scripsi vobis mea manu.
tr: ιδετε πηλικοις υμιν γραμμασιν εγραψα τη εμη χειρι
kjv: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.

vulg: quicumque volunt placere in carne hii cogunt vos circumcidi tantum ut crucis Christi persecutionem non patiantur
clem: Quicumque enim volunt placere in carne, hi cogunt vos circumcidi, tantum ut crucis Christi persecutionem non patiantur.
tr: οσοι θελουσιν ευπροσωπησαι εν σαρκι ουτοι αναγκαζουσιν υμας περιτεμνεσθαι μονον ινα μη τω σταυρω του χριστου διωκωνται
kjv: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

vulg: neque enim qui circumciduntur legem custodiunt sed volunt vos circumcidi ut in carne vestra glorientur
clem: Neque enim qui circumciduntur, legem custodiunt: sed volunt vos circumcidi, ut in carne vestra glorientur.
tr: ουδε γαρ οι περιτεμνομενοι αυτοι νομον φυλασσουσιν αλλα θελουσιν υμας περιτεμνεσθαι ινα εν τη υμετερα σαρκι καυχησωνται
kjv: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

vulg: mihi autem absit gloriari nisi in cruce Domini nostri Iesu Christi per quem mihi mundus crucifixus est et ego mundo
clem: Mihi autem absit gloriari, nisi in cruce Domini nostri Jesu Christi: per quem mihi mundus crucifixus est, et ego mundo.
tr: εμοι δε μη γενοιτο καυχασθαι ει μη εν τω σταυρω του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου δι ου εμοι κοσμος εσταυρωται καγω τω κοσμω
kjv: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

vulg: in Christo enim Iesu neque circumcisio aliquid valet neque praeputium sed nova creatura
clem: In Christo enim Jesu neque circumcisio aliquid valet, neque prputium, sed nova creatura.
tr: εν γαρ χριστω ιησου ουτε περιτομη τι ισχυει ουτε ακροβυστια αλλα καινη κτισις
kjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

vulg: et quicumque hanc regulam secuti fuerint pax super illos et misericordia et super Israhel Dei
clem: Et quicumque hanc regulam secuti fuerint, pax super illos, et misericordia, et super Isral Dei.
tr: και οσοι τω κανονι τουτω στοιχησουσιν ειρηνη επ αυτους και ελεος και επι τον ισραηλ του θεου
kjv: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

vulg: de cetero nemo mihi molestus sit ego enim stigmata Iesu in corpore meo porto
clem: De cetero, nemo mihi molestus sit: ego enim stigmata Domini Jesu in corpore meo porto.
tr: του λοιπου κοπους μοι μηδεις παρεχετω εγω γαρ τα στιγματα του κυριου ιησου εν τω σωματι μου βασταζω
kjv: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

vulg: gratia Domini nostri Iesu Christi cum spiritu vestro fratres amen
clem: Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi cum spiritu vestro, fratres. Amen.
tr: η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μετα του πνευματος υμων αδελφοι αμην [ προς γαλατας εγραφη απο ρωμης]
kjv: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
